definitions.short: Jehochanan , the name of eight Israelites
definitions.full: H3076. Yehochanan יוֺחָנָן יְהוֺחָנָן, proper name, masculine ᵐ5 mostly Ἰωαναν , Ἰωναν ( ׳י hath been gracious , compare חֲנַנְאֵל אֶלְחָנָן & references; also Phoenician בעליחן יחנבעל ) — 1. a. ׳יְהוֺ a priest Neh 12:13 ; b. high priest Ezra 10:6 = יוֺחָנָן Neh 12:22-23 , apparently = יוֺנָתָן 12:11 (twice in verse) ( ᵐ5 Ἰωναθαν ). 2 ׳יְהוֺ Levite Neh 12:42 . 3 ׳יְהוֺ son of Tobiah Neh 6:18 ( ᵐ5 Manuscripts Ἰωναθαν ). 4 ׳יְהוֺ porter in David's time 1Chr 26:3 ( ᵐ5 Ἰωνας , ᵐ5 L Ἰωναθαν ). 5 ׳יְהוֺ a Judaite captain 2Chr 17:15 apparently also 23:1 . 6 ׳יְהוֺ an Ephraimite 2Chr 28:12 . 7 ׳יְהוֺ an Israelite, Ezra's time Ezra 10:28 . 8 ׳יוֺ (& so all following) a Jewish captain, after fall of Jerusalem 2Kin 25:23 ; Jer 40:8 , 13 , 15 , 16 ; 41:11 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 ; 42:1 , 8 ; 43:2 , 4 , 5 9 eldest son of king Josiah 1Chr 3:15 ᵐ5 L Ἰωαχας (apparently = יְתוֺאָחָז 2Kin 23:30 + ). 10 a post-exilic prince of the line of David 1Chr 3:24 . 11 father of Azariah , priest in Solomon's time 1 Chronicles 5:35; 1 Chronicles 5:36. 12 two of David's mighty men : a. a Benjamite 1Chr 12:5 ; b. a Gadite 1Chr 12:13 . 13 a returning exile Ezra 8:12 .
